chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"A man should not break his fast in the Month of Ramadan except for a rightful cause."

key_terms.بِسَبِيلِ حَقٍّ: with a rightful and legitimate cause
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, the obligated time of fasting

ai.seo_question: When is a person allowed to break the fast in the Month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one must not break the fast in the Month of Ramadan except on the basis of a legitimate and rightful cause. It emphasizes the sanctity of the Ramadan fast and the legal limits governing when الإفطار is permitted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A man should not break his fast in the Month of Ramadan except for a rightful cause."
